factor: GGML_TP5_NORM_PREFETCH=0/1, default0; no changes to Q/norm workgroup sizes, model weights, numerics, timeouts, ownership or bank retirement. Subsequent rows remain in the existing order.
eligibility: Residual is an existing local shader binding whose availability is established by the existing pre-norm command dependencies. No inbox payload or canonical Y is read before its generation wait; no output is written on the success path before that wait.
validation: Production shader: all signed numerical fixture outputs against existing1e-6 gate for1/2/4 rows, plus withheld-generation NaN/sticky-failure/inactive-row tests. qualification: One symmetric pilot then, only if evidence justifies it, four fresh process pairs. Never call a no-wait isolated fixture improvement proof of hidden production wait.
theory: This optimization attacks exposed latency, not weight bytes. Do not lower bandwidth demand or claim new tensor precision from it.
